title.zh: 谷歌、亚马逊和博通向Anthropic提供770亿美元融资
title.en: 谷歌、亚马逊和博通向Anthropic提供770亿美元融资

current_state.zh:
据 BlockBeats 10 月 26 日消息，Anthropic 已从谷歌、亚马逊和博通处获得总计 770 亿美元的额外融资。每项协议均附带各自条件：亚马逊的融资与 Anthropic 达到特定算力里程碑挂钩，谷歌的 200 亿美元承诺则部分取决于 Anthropic 能否实现特定营收目标。

这些承诺将 Anthropic 的资金与算力建设和营收表现直接绑定，使资本投放与可衡量的运营里程碑挂钩，而非一次性投入。谷歌和亚马逊累计向 Anthropic 投资数百亿美元，已成为其最大股东。

在总额中，谷歌的部分为 200 亿美元承诺，部分取决于营收目标；亚马逊的协议则围绕算力容量里程碑设定。报道称，谷歌和亚马逊既是 Anthropic 的投资方，同时也是其竞争对手。
current_state.en: Anthropic obtained $77B in additional financing from Google, Amazon, and Broadcom, with each agreement carrying its own conditions—Amazon's tied to compute-capacity milestones and Google's $20B partly contingent on Anthropic hitting revenue targets.

updates.background_zh: 超大规模云服务商（如亚马逊 AWS、谷歌云等大型云厂商）已向 Anthropic 投入数十亿美元，帮助这家人工智能初创公司满足算力需求。博通提供半导体与基础设施软件，并在定制 AI 芯片业务上持续扩张，因而成为大规模 AI 算力建设中的相关参与方。
updates.background_en: Hyperscalers — large-scale cloud providers such as Amazon Web Services and Google Cloud — have poured billions into Anthropic to help the AI startup meet its compute needs. Broadcom supplies semiconductors and infrastructure software and has an expanding custom AI chip business, making it a relevant partner for large-scale AI compute buildouts.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该交易显示超大规模云厂商仍愿向前沿 AI 实验室投入与里程碑挂钩的大额资金，这一情绪渠道通常会传导至 AI 概念及去中心化算力相关加密代币的叙事。同时它也凸显 AI 算力需求高度集中于少数云厂商与芯片供应商，这种集中度构成了 AI 相关加密项目对标的底层基础设施环境。
updates.market_impact_en: The deal signals continued hyperscaler willingness to commit large, milestone-linked capital to frontier AI labs, a sentiment channel that typically feeds narratives around AI- and decentralized-compute-related crypto tokens. It also underscores how much AI compute demand is being routed through a small set of cloud and chip suppliers, a concentration that shapes the infrastructure backdrop AI-adjacent crypto projects benchmark against.
